description: BD Allocation silver merge - convert the allocation bronze files landed by the live 49F REST session chain to silver parquet. The Playwright portal download this document used to run is removed: BD added MFA and it failed every run since 2026-06-23.

runCommand: echo "=== BD Allocation silver merge - $TODAY ===" | tee $LOG
# NO PORTAL LOGIN AND NO PORTAL CREDENTIALS, BY DESIGN. The Playwright portal download that stood
# here failed every run since Black Diamond added MFA (~2026-06-23; 70 of 70 dated logs). The allocation
# bronze is landed daily by the live 49F REST session chain, and the merge below reads it.
# Run allocation silver conversion - capture exit code
aws s3 cp s3://opal-data-bd/scripts/merge-daily-incremental.py . 2>&1 | tee -a $LOG || echo 'WARNING: Script download failed' | tee -a $LOG
# Arm the shutdown BEFORE the failure branch. The `exit 1` below is what makes SSM report the
# truth, but an exit that PRECEDES the shutdown strands this t3.medium on every failing run, and
# no CloudWatch auto-stop exists for it (NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-S17). Same order as
# Exit non-zero if the merge failed so SSM and CloudWatch reflect the failure
echo "NOTE: bd-price-update is NOT invoked by this document (MX-s-14 carve-out; it has been unreachable since 2026-06-22)." | tee -a $LOG
